create.title: Set up your workspace
create.subtitle: A workspace holds your team, social accounts and posts. You can change these later in settings.
create.name: Workspace name
create.nameHint: Usually your company, brand or client.
create.timezoneHint: Posts are scheduled and shown in this time zone.
create.timezoneSearch: Search by city, country or offset
create.verifyFirst: Verify your email address before creating a workspace.

connect.title: Connect your first account
connect.body: Socioboard publishes to Facebook Pages and Instagram professional accounts. You sign in with the network, then choose which of your accounts to add.
connect.readOnly: An admin of this workspace connects its accounts. You can carry on without one.

post.title: Write your first post
post.body: Write it once, see how it looks on each network, then publish it or keep it as a draft.
post.bodyNoAccounts: With no account connected yet, it’s kept as a draft. Connect one whenever you’re ready.
post.readOnly: Someone who writes posts in this workspace takes it from here.
